boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Marist University
boards.description: Ten currently listed food destinations in Poughkeepsie with late-evening or overnight availability; confirm service mode before leaving campus.

cards.title: The Palace Diner
cards.subtitle: 194 Washington Street, Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Use the diner’s 24/7 schedule when you need a meal at an uncommon hour; its official page lists the address beside St. Francis Hospital.
cards.short_summary: A downtown diner whose official site lists nonstop service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Palace Diner lists its address as 194 Washington Street, Poughkeepsie, and says it is open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists the diner as open 24/7; verify transportation and any service changes before going.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Main Street
cards.subtitle: 753 Main Street, Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Check the restaurant or drive-thru when a late meal is needed; the location page lists both restaurant and drive-thru service every day.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street Wendy’s with 24-hour restaurant and drive-thru listings.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists its 753 Main Street Poughkeepsie restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours as 24 hours daily; check live ordering availability before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Main Street
cards.subtitle: 755 Main Street, Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru option for a clearly listed after-midnight stop; indoor hours are separately listed and end earlier on the official page.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street Taco Bell with drive-thru hours into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 755 Main Street through 2:30 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 2:30 a.m. Sun–Wed and 3:00 a.m. Thu–Sat; dine-in hours differ, so check before leaving.

cards.title: Domino’s on Taft Avenue
cards.subtitle: 10 Taft Avenue, Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order through the store page when the posted late closing time fits your plans; keep the order confirmation handy.
cards.short_summary: A Taft Avenue pizza shop whose official page lists service until 2 a.m. today.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page identifies the Poughkeepsie store at 10 Taft Avenue and lists it as open until 2:00 a.m. today.
cards.access_notes: Official store page currently lists “Open Today Until 2:00 AM”; location hours can vary, so confirm in the ordering flow.

cards.title: Sundaze Burgers
cards.subtitle: 33 Academy Street, Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Plan a Thursday–Saturday visit around the posted 2 a.m. closing time, and use the restaurant’s ordering link to confirm service before heading downtown.
cards.short_summary: A burger counter at The Academy with late Thursday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Sundaze Burgers lists 33 Academy Street, Poughkeepsie, and hours until 2:00 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Thursday–Saturday hours until 2:00 a.m.; its page shows differing weekly-hour displays, so reconfirm before travel.

cards.title: KFC on Main Street
cards.subtitle: 746-50 Main Street, Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check pickup, delivery, or drive-thru availability; the posted daily schedule runs through 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street chicken restaurant with a listed 11 p.m. close every day.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC lists its restaurant at 746-50 Main Street in Poughkeepsie as open 10:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists daily hours until 11:00 p.m. and identifies carry-out, delivery, and drive-thru service; check availability before departure.

cards.entity_name: Mama La’s Food For The Soul
cards.title: Mama La’s Food For The Soul
cards.subtitle: 307 Main Street, Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online ordering page for its evening service window; schedule pickup or delivery only after confirming the current menu is accepting orders.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street restaurant with online ordering listed into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Mama La’s Food For The Soul’s ordering page lists 307 Main Street and an evening online-ordering window from 7:00 p.m. to 2:25 a.m.
cards.source_title: Mama La’s Food For The Soul — Online Ordering
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s online ordering page currently lists 7:00 p.m.–2:25 a.m.; this is an ordering window, so verify pickup or delivery at checkout.

cards.title: Midnight Munchie Company
cards.subtitle: Poughkeepsie, NY
cards.notes: Check the bakery’s own site for the day’s cookie selection and operating status before making an evening order or arranging pickup.
cards.short_summary: A Poughkeepsie cookie business whose official site lists a 10 p.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Midnight Munchie Company’s official site lists Poughkeepsie, a phone contact, and hours of noon to 10:00 p.m. today.
cards.access_notes: Official site currently lists hours until 10:00 p.m.; it does not provide a street address on the cited page, so confirm fulfillment details directly.

cards.title: Cocina La Cabanita de Oaxaca
cards.subtitle: 763 Main Street, Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Use the official restaurant site to confirm the late-week schedule, then place a food order or call ahead before going to Main Street.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street Oaxacan restaurant listing 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Cocina La Cabanita de Oaxaca lists 763 Main Street and hours until 10:00 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday until 10:00 p.m.; weekday hours differ, so check the posted schedule before travel.

cards.title: Farmers & Chefs
cards.subtitle: 40 Albany Street, Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: For a later Friday or Saturday dinner, check the restaurant’s own hours and order options before departing; the posted closing time is 10 p.m.

cards.evidence_claim: Farmers & Chefs lists its Poughkeepsie address as 40 Albany Street and hours until 10:00 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday service until 10:00 p.m.; confirm current kitchen and takeout availability directly before travel.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Marist settings for studying, meeting, making, viewing art, recreation, and campus events; check each location’s current access rules before going.

cards.title: James A. Cannavino Library
cards.subtitle: Library study areas, computer lab, and atrium gathering space
cards.notes: Choose seating that fits your task, then use the library’s desktops or laptop loans. The top floor also houses academic-support services.
cards.short_summary: A three-floor library built for both individual and group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist states that Cannavino Library offers seating for individual and group studying, is the campus’s largest computer lab, and has academic-support functions on its top floor.
cards.source_title: James A. Cannavino Library | Marist University
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to current library policies and building access.

cards.title: Murray Student Center
cards.subtitle: Campus hub for meetings, services, lounges, and events
cards.notes: Use the lounges or meeting areas as a starting point for a club gathering, then check the building’s current facility hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A student-services and activities hub with lounges, meeting rooms, dining, theatre, and music spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist describes the Murray Student Center as a focal point for university life where students meet, organize, and attend events; it lists lounges and meeting rooms among its facilities.
cards.access_notes: Facility hours and room availability vary; follow current Student Center policies.

cards.title: Fern Tor
cards.subtitle: 13-acre nature preserve at the north end of campus
cards.notes: Take the marked trail network for a daylight reset or nature observation. Stay on established paths and plan around the sunrise-to-sundown schedule.
cards.short_summary: A campus nature preserve with trails, a pond, creek, and Hudson River overlook.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist identifies Fern Tor as a 13-acre campus nature preserve with an accessible trail network, a creek and pond, and hours from sunrise to sundown.
cards.access_notes: Open sunrise to sundown; use established trails and observe preserve guidance.

cards.title: Longview Park
cards.subtitle: Marist riverfront park on the Hudson River
cards.notes: Bring coursework or meet friends by the waterfront during daylight, and look for Student Activities programming when an event is scheduled there.
cards.short_summary: A 12-acre riverfront setting with direct waterfront access for the Marist community.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist’s self-guided tour says Longview Park is open to the Marist community, provides students direct waterfront access, and hosts Student Activities and Student Programming Council events.
cards.access_notes: Waterfront conditions and event access vary; follow posted site guidance.

cards.title: Maker Lab
cards.subtitle: Steel Plant creative workspace for Red Foxes
cards.notes: Check the workshop schedule, then bring a class project or creative idea. Ask about materials before assuming a personal project has no supply cost.
cards.short_summary: A Steel Plant making space with equipment, workshops, and project materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist reports that the Maker Lab in Steel Plant is open to all Red Foxes and that students use its equipment and resources for creative work.
cards.source_title: Maker Lab Sparks Creativity and Community | Marist University
cards.access_notes: Availability, supervision, and material costs can vary by project and workshop.

cards.title: Marist Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Exhibition gallery in Steel Plant Studios
cards.notes: Check the gallery calendar before visiting, then spend time with the current exhibition or attend an announced student, faculty, or community reception.
cards.short_summary: A Steel Plant gallery that presents exhibitions, including student-led work.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist documented a student-led exhibition at the Marist Art Gallery in Steel Plant Studios attended by students, faculty, staff, and community members.
cards.source_title: Student Captures Asia Study Abroad Experience Through Art | Marist University
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and public hours change; confirm the current show and access details.

cards.title: James J. McCann Recreational Center
cards.subtitle: Recreation center with fitness, intramural, and aquatic facilities
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate the fitness, club and intramural, arena, and natatorium facilities, then confirm eligibility and operating details with Recreation.
cards.short_summary: Marist’s central recreation complex for fitness, aquatics, intramurals, and athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist’s campus map lists the James J. McCann Recreational Center with a fitness center, club and intramural center, natatorium, arena, and aerobic center.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and program participation are subject to current Recreation policies.

cards.title: Lowell Thomas Communications Center
cards.subtitle: Communication and arts building with Media Center and community offices
cards.notes: Use the campus map to find the Media Center and School of Communication and the Arts, and check department guidance before seeking access to specialized spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named academic setting for communication, media, and arts-related work.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist’s campus map lists the Lowell Thomas Communications Center as home to the School of Communication and the Arts, Media Center, and Center for Social Media.
cards.access_notes: Specialized labs and media spaces may have departmental access requirements.

cards.title: Dyson Center
cards.subtitle: Academic building with Idea Lab, mock courtroom, and student-run café
cards.notes: Meet classmates around your schedule, then use the building’s named learning spaces when they are available. Respect any class, lab, or event reservations.
cards.short_summary: A multidisciplinary academic building with several named applied-learning spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist’s campus map lists Dyson Center with the Idea Lab, Investment Center, Marketing Lab, Mock Courtroom, and Saxbys student-run café.
cards.access_notes: Classroom, lab, and café access depend on current schedules and policies.

cards.title: Cornell Boathouse
cards.subtitle: Historic riverfront boathouse in Longview Park
cards.notes: Notice the restored historic structure from Longview Park, and attend only university or community functions for which you are invited or registered.
cards.short_summary: A restored historic boathouse whose upper floor hosts campus meetings and events.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist says the Cornell Boathouse’s second level hosts campus luncheons, meetings, and other events, while the building remains a functional boathouse.
cards.access_notes: Not a drop-in venue; enter only for authorized functions or permitted access.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named Hudson Valley outdoor destinations for an admission-free walk, picnic, or nature break near Marist University.

cards.title: Walk Black Creek Preserve
cards.subtitle: Esopus, NY — near Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a trail walk or shoreline pause; use the preserve’s posted visitor guidance and stay on marked routes.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost preserve outing with trails and Hudson River shoreline access.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson identifies Black Creek Preserve as one of its parks, and states that all Scenic Hudson parks are open daily free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Scenic Hudson states its parks are open daily free of charge; check the preserve page for current alerts and visitor rules before leaving.

cards.title: Take a Peach Hill Park loop
cards.subtitle: Poughkeepsie, NY
cards.notes: Meet for a walk, picnic, or wildlife watch between dawn and dusk; pack water and use the park’s designated trails.
cards.short_summary: A Poughkeepsie park for a simple, free outdoors hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson says Peach Hill Park is free and open year-round, dawn to dusk, and lists hiking, picnicking, and wildlife activities.
cards.access_notes: Free year-round, dawn to dusk, according to Scenic Hudson. Bring any food or gear you want; no purchase is required to enter.

cards.title: Picnic at Esopus Meadows Preserve
cards.subtitle: Ulster Park, NY — near Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Plan a low-key trail-and-pavilion meetup, then take the shoreline route to the river lookout before sunset.
cards.short_summary: A free preserve with trails, a pavilion, and river views.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson says Esopus Meadows Preserve is free and open year-round, sunrise to sunset, and offers hiking and picnicking.
cards.access_notes: Free year-round, sunrise to sunset. Seasonal facilities may vary, so review the preserve page’s alerts before visiting.

cards.title: See Esopus Meadows Lighthouse
cards.subtitle: Esopus, NY — near Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Use this small riverfront park for a conversation walk and lighthouse view; pair it with the adjacent preserve if you want more trail time.
cards.short_summary: A named riverfront park with a view of Esopus Meadows Lighthouse.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson identifies Lighthouse Park as a public park in Esopus and lists walking, fishing, wildlife watching, and dog walking on leash.
cards.access_notes: Scenic Hudson states its parks are open daily free of charge. The park is owned by the Town of Esopus; follow local park guidance.

cards.title: Hike Franny Reese State Park
cards.subtitle: Highland, NY — across the Hudson from Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Choose a marked trail for a daytime friend hang, and allow time to read the site’s interpretation of the park’s history and landscape.
cards.short_summary: A named Highland trail destination for a free outdoor walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson lists Franny Reese State Park among its parks and states that Scenic Hudson parks are open daily free of charge.
cards.source_title: Franny Reese State Park | Scenic Hudson
cards.access_notes: Scenic Hudson states its parks are open daily free of charge. Review the park page for trail conditions, rules, and access details.

cards.title: Make a Shaupeneak Ridge trail plan
cards.subtitle: Esopus, NY — near Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Pick a trail length that fits the group, keep the meetup in daylight, and use the preserve’s map to choose a marked route.
cards.short_summary: A free ridge preserve for a daylight trail outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson identifies Shaupeneak Ridge as one of its parks, and states that all Scenic Hudson parks are open daily free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Scenic Hudson states its parks are open daily free of charge; consult the individual park page for current conditions and rules.

cards.title: Stroll Poets’ Walk Park
cards.subtitle: Red Hook, NY — north of Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Walk the paths with a friend and pause at the pavilion or river overlooks; bring only what you need and leave the grounds as you found them.
cards.short_summary: A free Hudson Valley park for a relaxed scenic walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson identifies Poets’ Walk Park as one of its parks, and states that all Scenic Hudson parks are open daily free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Scenic Hudson states its parks are open daily free of charge. Confirm route, rules, and any alerts on the park page before travel.

cards.title: Walk the Long Dock waterfront
cards.subtitle: Beacon, NY — south of Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Meet for a waterfront walk, then use the park’s paths and river edge for an unhurried catch-up without buying anything.
cards.short_summary: A free Beacon waterfront park for walking and taking in the Hudson.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson identifies Long Dock Park as one of its parks, and states that all Scenic Hudson parks are open daily free of charge.
cards.source_title: Scenic Hudson’s Long Dock Park | Scenic Hudson
cards.access_notes: Scenic Hudson states its parks are open daily free of charge. Follow the park’s current visitor guidance and use care near the water.

cards.title: Explore Madam Brett Park
cards.subtitle: Beacon, NY — south of Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Set up a daytime walk on the park’s listed routes, keeping the group together and checking the map before you start.
cards.short_summary: A named Beacon park for a free walking or nature-focused hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson identifies Madam Brett Park as one of its parks, and states that all Scenic Hudson parks are open daily free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Scenic Hudson states its parks are open daily free of charge. Check the individual page for current trail information and regulations.

cards.title: Meet for a Mount Beacon hike
cards.subtitle: Beacon, NY — south of Poughkeepsie
cards.notes: Make this a daylight hiking plan: choose a marked route, share water, and turn around early enough to finish before sunset.
cards.short_summary: A free named mountain park for a planned group hike.
cards.evidence_claim: Scenic Hudson identifies Mount Beacon Park as one of its parks, and states that all Scenic Hudson parks are open daily free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Scenic Hudson states its parks are open daily free of charge. Review the park page and select a route suited to your group.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, documented spaces for individual work, computer-based research, group meetings, and academic support at Marist University.

cards.title: James A. Cannavino Library
cards.subtitle: Three-story library overlooking the campus green and Hudson River
cards.notes: Start with the library’s varied seating areas, then use its physical collections or borrow a laptop for work anywhere in the building.
cards.short_summary: A flexible campus library setting for solo or group coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist says Cannavino Library has seating for individual and group studying, 80 desktops, and laptops that may be used anywhere in the building.
cards.source_title: James A. Cannavino Library | Marist University
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours page before visiting; campus resources and borrowing may require Marist credentials.

cards.title: E-scriptorium
cards.subtitle: Cannavino Library computer lab
cards.notes: Use one of the 46 listed workstations when your assignment needs campus software, then save files to your preferred storage before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A library computer lab for research and software-based coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist’s family handbook identifies the E-scriptorium as the library’s largest computer lab, with 46 workstations and software supporting Marist classes.
cards.access_notes: Located in Cannavino Library; consult current library hours and workstation availability on arrival.

cards.title: Frank A. Fusco Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cannavino Library reading room
cards.notes: Bring a reading-heavy task and settle into this named library room, documented with study furnishings for individual or small-group work.
cards.short_summary: A named reading-room environment inside the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist Archives documents the Frank A. Fusco Reading Room as part of the library’s study space, with options including soft seating, carrels, and tables.
cards.source_title: Marist Magazine, Summer 2000 | Marist Archives and Special Collections
cards.access_notes: This is within Cannavino Library; verify current room availability and library access before planning a session.

cards.entity_name: Margaret W. Mair Executive Presentation Room
cards.title: Margaret W. Mair Executive Presentation Room
cards.subtitle: Cannavino Library presentation setting
cards.notes: Use this room only for a presentation-focused session: organize slides, rehearse transitions, and confirm any room-use process with the library first.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped setting for presentation preparation.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist Archives identifies the Margaret W. Mair Executive Presentation Room and documents its large-screen projection and presentation technology.
cards.source_title: Marist Magazine, Summer 2000 | Marist Archives and Special Collections
cards.access_notes: A presentation-oriented room in Cannavino Library; confirm current reservation or access requirements with the library.

cards.title: Library 314 Study Room
cards.subtitle: Cannavino Library, Room 314
cards.notes: For a scheduled work block, use the Marist App reservation process listed by the university and arrive with your group’s materials ready.
cards.short_summary: A specifically identified library study room with a documented reservation workflow.
cards.evidence_claim: A Marist reservation guide lists Library 314 Study Room among locations that use the Marist App mobile reservation system.
cards.source_title: Mobile Scheduling of Shared Spaces on Campus | Marist University
cards.access_notes: Use the Marist App reservation instructions on the source page; availability and eligibility are not guaranteed.

cards.title: Presentation Practice Room
cards.subtitle: Cannavino Library
cards.notes: Reserve this room when you need to rehearse and record a talk; build in time to test the screen and camera before your practice run.
cards.short_summary: A library room designed around recorded presentation rehearsal.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist’s library map links to a page for reserving and using a Presentation Practice Room with a built-in presentation screen and camera.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is indicated by the library; use the linked room-reservation information to confirm current access details.

cards.title: Commons Lounge
cards.subtitle: Ground floor, Murray Student Center
cards.notes: Use the lounge for a laptop session or reading break; its listed seating, microwave, and coffee maker support longer on-campus stretches.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center lounge with documented study use and extended evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist describes the Commons Lounge as a ground-floor Student Center space used for studying, with seating and student amenities.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Mon–Thu 8:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m.; Fri 8:30 a.m.–2 a.m.; Sat–Sun 10 a.m.–2 a.m. The page frames it as a commuter space.

cards.title: Commuter Student Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Murray Student Center commuter area
cards.notes: Plan a group meeting around a reservable room with tables and chairs, and bring a laptop if you expect to use the listed printer.
cards.short_summary: Reservable Student Center group-work rooms with basic tech resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist’s commuter-student page lists reservable study rooms with tables and chairs for group meetings, plus laptops and a networked printer.
cards.access_notes: The resource is presented for commuter students; ask the Commuter Student Coordinator about current reservation eligibility.

cards.title: Marian Hall Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Marian Hall residence hall
cards.notes: If you live in Marian Hall, use the documented second-floor quiet room for a nearby focused session and respect residence-hall access rules.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall quiet room available within Marian Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist identifies one quiet study room on the second floor of Marian Hall and states that building entry is by Marist ID-card swipe access.
cards.access_notes: Resident-hall access requires a Marist ID card; this space is most practical for Marian Hall residents.

cards.title: Academic Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Library 331, Cannavino Library
cards.notes: Pair independent study with academic support by checking in during office hours for tutoring, proofreading, counseling, or study-skills guidance.
cards.short_summary: A Library 331 academic-support hub for structured study help.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist lists the Academic Learning Center in Library 331 and says it provides academic support through tutoring, proofreading, and academic counseling.
cards.access_notes: Listed office hours are Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; services may have separate appointment procedures.

cards.evidence_claim: Marist's around-town guide lists Salsa Fresca at 3434 North Road, 0.3 miles from the North Gate.
cards.access_notes: Off-campus restaurant; confirm current service details directly before visiting.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Marist gatherings and practices, from Welcome Week field games to a campus tree lit with thousands of LEDs.

cards.title: Make Family Weekend a Red Fox reunion
cards.subtitle: Annual Marist tradition · campuswide
cards.notes: Plan around the Friday-through-Sunday program, then use the official schedule to choose family-friendly performances, games, and gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A fall weekend that brings students and their families together on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist identifies Family Weekend as a tradition and says the program runs from Friday evening through Sunday afternoon.
cards.access_notes: Dates and registration details are posted by Student Affairs; some listed activities may have fees.

cards.title: Join Fox Fest’s spring reset
cards.subtitle: Annual spring celebration · campuswide
cards.notes: Watch for the Residence Life schedule and pick an activity, outdoor gathering, or evening program that fits your day on campus.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Residence Life celebration expanded into a full-day campus event in 2026.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist calls Fox Fest its annual spring celebration and a long Residence Life staple becoming a broader spring tradition.
cards.source_title: Fox Fest, Marist’s Annual Spring Celebration, Expands into All-Day Event
cards.access_notes: Programming, timing, and any activity-specific requirements vary by year.

cards.title: Mark the calendar for Spring Concert
cards.subtitle: Annual campus event · Marist University
cards.notes: Check Student Programming Council announcements for the artist, venue, entry rules, and companion events before making plans.
cards.short_summary: The annual concert anchors Marist’s spring campus-life calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist lists the spring concert among annual community gatherings and identifies it as a highly anticipated annual event.
cards.source_title: Student Activities and Clubs — Marist University
cards.access_notes: Artist, date, location, and admission details change annually.

cards.title: See the Holiday Tree come alive
cards.subtitle: Annual ceremony · outside Our Lady Seat of Wisdom Chapel
cards.notes: Bundle up for the lighting and arrive early enough to hear the music and see the campus centerpiece switch on.
cards.short_summary: A holiday gathering centered on Marist’s illuminated campus tree.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist describes the Holiday Tree lighting as an annual event; it says campus tree celebrations date to the 1980s.
cards.source_title: Holiday Celebrations Across Cultures Bring Campus Community Together
cards.access_notes: The ceremony’s date, start time, and program are announced each holiday season.

cards.title: Share a P.S. I Love You message
cards.subtitle: Second Friday in February · Murray Student Center
cards.notes: Visit the student-center tables, take part in the positive-message activities, and use the event’s support resources thoughtfully.
cards.short_summary: An annual Marist observance promoting kindness, mental-health awareness, and suicide prevention.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist calls P.S. I Love You Day its annual tradition of honoring love, kindness, and positivity, held on the second Friday in February.
cards.access_notes: Annual activities are hosted on campus; consult Student Affairs for current participation details.

cards.title: Start with the New Student Welcome
cards.subtitle: Orientation tradition · Marist University
cards.notes: Treat this orientation gathering as your first campus-wide checkpoint, then follow the current schedule for your student group.
cards.short_summary: A formal annual welcome moment for incoming Marist students.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist’s orientation schedule describes the New Student Welcome as an annual tradition and the moment incoming students are welcomed.
cards.access_notes: Orientation schedules differ by cohort and year; use the current official schedule.

cards.title: Rally at the Red Fox Rumble
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week field-day games · Marist University
cards.notes: Bring comfortable clothes and join the Welcome Week field-day activities when the current first-year schedule announces them.
cards.short_summary: A first-year game tradition that Marist recreated as part of Fox Fest programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist’s Fox Fest coverage identifies the Red Fox Rumble as Welcome Week field day-style games for first-year students.
cards.source_title: Fox Fest, Marist’s Annual Spring Celebration, Expands into All-Day Event
cards.access_notes: Participation details and scheduling are released with Welcome Week programming.

cards.title: Take part in the Giving Tree Project
cards.subtitle: December service tradition · Marist community
cards.notes: Look for the seasonal giving instructions, select a requested item only if you can fulfill it, and follow the posted delivery steps.
cards.short_summary: A December community-giving project coordinated through Marist’s spiritual-life and service work.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist says the Giving Tree Project provides holiday gifts to local families through campus clubs, organizations, offices, and individuals.
cards.access_notes: Participation typically involves donating requested gifts; follow the current project instructions.

cards.title: Turn November into Hunger Awareness Month
cards.subtitle: November service programming · Marist University
cards.notes: Choose a current service, food-collection, or awareness activity and use the official program details to participate responsibly.
cards.short_summary: A November series that combines hunger education, fundraising, and community collection efforts.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist identifies November as Hunger Awareness Month and lists its Walk/Run for Hunger, food collection, meal, and Petition Day activities.
cards.access_notes: Activities and contribution options vary each year; some participation may involve a donation.

cards.title: Use Marist’s first-year mentor tradition
cards.subtitle: First Year Experience · Marist University
cards.notes: Meet your assigned mentor early, bring practical questions, and use their connections to navigate campus resources and organizations.
cards.short_summary: A mentoring practice begun in the late 1970s to help new students transition and succeed.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist says its mentorship tradition began in the late 1970s and that mentors connect first-year students with support and campus life.
cards.access_notes: Available to first-year students through the First Year Experience program.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Marist University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A calm, under-21-safe first-weekend route: get oriented, settle into campus, find creative and reflective spaces, then take in the Hudson Valley.

cards.title: Start with a self-guided campus loop
cards.subtitle: First stop · Marist Campus
cards.notes: Open the official campus map, locate the library and Student Center, then use the numbered destinations to make your own first-day walking route.
cards.short_summary: A practical way to put names and buildings together before the weekend fills up.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist’s official campus map identifies academic buildings, the Murray Student Center, dining halls, Student Activities, and other campus destinations.
cards.access_notes: Use the official map as a navigation aid; observe campus access rules.

cards.title: Choose a library seat with a view
cards.subtitle: Settle-in stop · Campus green and Hudson River side
cards.notes: Pick an individual or group seating area, browse the collections, or use a desktop workstation while you get acquainted with academic support spaces.
cards.short_summary: A three-story academic hub with study seating, collections, technology, and a coffee bar.
cards.evidence_claim: Cannavino Library has seating for individual and group study, physical and online collections, computer access, and academic-support functions.
cards.source_title: James A. Cannavino Library - Marist University
cards.access_notes: Campus building; confirm current building access and service hours before visiting.

cards.title: Find the campus’s gathering point
cards.subtitle: Midday stop · Murray Student Center
cards.notes: Walk through to spot the student lounge, meeting rooms, Student Government office, theatre spaces, dining services, and the campus bookstore for later use.
cards.short_summary: A central building for student services, events, dining, music, and meeting spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Murray Student Center includes meeting rooms, dining services, a student lounge, Student Government, theatre and music spaces, and the campus bookstore.
cards.access_notes: Campus building; individual spaces and events may have separate access arrangements.

cards.title: Pause on the four-acre campus green
cards.subtitle: Afternoon reset · Adjacent to Murray Student Center
cards.notes: Bring a book or meet a new classmate outdoors, then use the nearby Student Center as your next indoor waypoint when you are ready to continue.
cards.short_summary: An open campus lawn beside the Student Center with Hudson River views.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist describes a four-acre campus green adjacent to the Student Center that overlooks the Hudson River.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted campus rules and weather guidance.

cards.title: Make a first meal plan
cards.subtitle: Dinner stop · North End complex
cards.notes: Check the current dining information, then choose an on-campus meal that fits your plan and dietary needs before heading to an evening activity.
cards.short_summary: One of Marist’s on-campus dining locations in the North End complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist lists North End Dining Hall on its campus map and describes international cuisine among dining offerings in the North End complex.
cards.access_notes: Meals require an applicable dining purchase or plan; verify current menus and hours with Marist Dining.

cards.title: Look for a student theatre night
cards.subtitle: Evening option · Murray Student Center
cards.notes: Check the Marist Theatre calendar or club updates for a production, then arrive with enough time to find the theatre and review any ticket instructions.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Center theatre used by Marist’s theatre community and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Nelly Goletti Theatre is located in the Murray Student Center, and Marist Theatre produces multiple productions each year.
cards.access_notes: Performance availability and ticketing vary; check the current event listing before going.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady Seat of Wisdom Chapel
cards.title: Take a quiet chapel break
cards.subtitle: Reflection stop · Library-side entrance
cards.notes: Use the daily quiet-prayer hours for a brief, respectful pause; the nearby interfaith prayer room is also accessed from the chapel’s library side.
cards.short_summary: A campus space for prayer, reflection, services, and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist states that Our Lady Seat of Wisdom Chapel is open daily for quiet prayer from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Daily quiet-prayer hours are 7:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; be respectful of services and other users.

cards.title: Walk the riverfront at Longview Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday daytime · Marist Hudson River waterfront
cards.notes: Follow the bike/walk path, stop at the fishing pier or gazebo, and keep to designated public paths while taking in the Hudson River scenery.
cards.short_summary: A 12-acre Marist riverfront park with a path, pier, gazebo, boathouses, and views.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist describes Longview Park as a 12-acre riverfront park with a bike/walk path, fishing pier, historic Cornell Boathouse, and gazebo.
cards.access_notes: Use designated paths and waterfront areas; conditions and event use can affect access.

cards.title: Spot a piece of Regatta Row history
cards.subtitle: Riverfront detail · Longview Park
cards.notes: View the restored two-story boathouse from the park, then compare it with the adjacent Marist Boathouse while staying outside operational rowing areas.
cards.short_summary: A restored historic boathouse on Marist’s Hudson River campus waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Marist identifies the historic Cornell Boathouse as one of two campus boathouses on the Hudson River and says its upper level hosts campus events.
cards.access_notes: View from public park areas; boathouse interiors and events have separate access requirements.

cards.entity_name: Walkway Over the Hudson State Historic Park
cards.title: End with a Hudson crossing
cards.subtitle: Sunday daytime · Poughkeepsie entrance at 61 Parker Avenue
cards.notes: Use the Poughkeepsie approach for a daylight walk or ride across the pedestrian bridge; check weather and closing time before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A 1.28-mile elevated pedestrian bridge over the Hudson River with free regular-hours access.
cards.evidence_claim: Walkway Over the Hudson is a 1.28-mile elevated pedestrian bridge, and access is free during regular operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 7:00 a.m. to sunset, weather permitting; confirm the day’s closing time and conditions before visiting.
